description: MIRA Claim — an atomic, generalized assertion that (proposes to) answer a research question. Maps mira.yaml class Claim (mixins Argument, NodeSchema). DRAFT.

main.description: A claim. Forward edges the claim's author owns (addresses / supports / opposes) are inlined here; third-party assertions about this claim use science.mira.relation. Inverse edges (addressedBy, supportedBy, opposedBy) are AppView-derived.

description.description: MIRA dgb:description, inline form — the assertion text.

attributedTo.description: MIRA creator, only when it differs from the signing repo DID.

addresses.description: MIRA addresses — Questions this claim (proposes to) answer.

supports.description: MIRA supports — Claims this claim supports (a Claim is an Argument).

opposes.description: MIRA opposes — Claims this claim opposes.
